title: Diyanet Vakfı meali, earlier ungrouped e-text (circulates online also as "Adem Uğur")
author: Ali Özek, Hayreddin Karaman, Ali Turgut, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadreddin Gümüş (TDV committee)
translator: Ali Özek, Hayreddin Karaman, Ali Turgut, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadreddin Gümüş (TDV committee)
edition: tanzil tr.vakfi ("Diyanet Vakfı"); per-ayah text without the official verse groups
licence: tanzil.net translation terms: non-commercial use, verbatim, cite tanzil.net; rights remain with translator/publisher; local research copy only.
notes: Identity: wording equals the official grouped TDV meal (kd ML=4) wherever that meal does not group (1:5, 1:7, 93:7) and shows an earlier revision elsewhere (22:46 "(Sana karşı çıkanlar)" vs kd "(Seni yalanlayanlar)"). The same e-text is labelled "Adem Uğur" on mealler.org and fawazahmed0 (tur-ademugur); no evidence was found that it is a separate Adem Uğur translation, so the label is treated as a misattribution of the TDV text (host label kept here for the record). 10 merged verse groups stored once as a..a_end.
